title: OTHRYS Learning & Development
purpose: Permanent training, evaluation, troubleshooting and security proving ground for OTHRYS, JEV and external AI candidates.

domains.label: OTHRYS Curriculum
domains.purpose: Construction capability and the ten-level OTHRYS curriculum.

domains.label: JEV Trainer
domains.purpose: System One calibration, stability and circuit qualification.

domains.label: Dual Brain
domains.purpose: Core/JEV agreement, disagreement, calibration and hybrid value.

domains.label: Benchmarks
domains.purpose: Comparable reasoning, coding, agent/tool and long-context evaluation.

domains.label: Aegis Security
domains.purpose: Adversarial security, containment, isolation and recovery tests.

domains.label: Troubleshooting & Recovery
domains.purpose: Turn incidents and historical failures into replayable regression tests.

registrations.name: Atomic regression baseline
registrations.purpose: Re-run a representative atomic task under the current dual-brain-era stack and compare with the legacy corpus.

registrations.name: OTHRYS reconstruction exam
registrations.purpose: Reconstruct an OTHRYS-class system from declared architecture, admitted Blocks and explicit evidence without hidden local state.

registrations.name: Autonomous construction exam
registrations.purpose: Research, blueprint, compose, build, verify, repair and release under operator gates.

registrations.name: Recursive OTHRYS exam
registrations.purpose: Improve OTHRYS using OTHRYS while preserving architecture, authority boundaries and independent proof.

registrations.name: Router calibration baseline
registrations.purpose: Measure JEV routing accuracy, order stability, critical misses and token/latency cost.

registrations.name: Core vs JEV routing agreement
registrations.purpose: Run the same bounded routing cases through Core and JEV, record disagreement, then measure hybrid value.

registrations.name: Benchmark adapter smoke
registrations.purpose: Prove benchmark adapters can register exact task/config/model versions and return comparable receipts.

registrations.name: Prompt-injection containment baseline
registrations.purpose: Measure whether untrusted instructions can alter authority, tool scope, secrets, knowledge admission or system behavior.

registrations.name: Incident replay baseline
registrations.purpose: Convert one historical failure into a deterministic replay with before/after proof and retained lesson.
